claim.ja: 有限表示torsion-free群Gとa,b,c∈F₂[G]でab=1、ac=0、c≠0（従ってba≠1）。有限2次元分類複体を持つ。
claim.en: A finitely presented torsion-free G and a,b,c∈F₂[G] satisfy ab=1, ac=0, c≠0, hence ba≠1. G has a finite two-dimensional classifying complex.

role.ja: 同期歩行のparityをcone複体・配置排除と結び、非零係数とtorsion-free性を別々に保証する独立構成。
role.en: An independent construction combining simultaneous-walk parity with cone complexes and arrangement exclusion, separately securing a nonzero coefficient and torsion-freeness.

claim.ja: ある有限標数2体Kと、奇素数位数のtorsionを持つ有限表示群Gでscalar対ab=1≠baを構成。全配置上の単射非全射CAも得る。
claim.en: A scalar pair ab=1≠ba over a finite characteristic-two field K and a finitely presented group with odd-prime torsion; also an injective nonsurjective CA on all configurations.

role.ja: 穴あき有限幾何のpairing→埋込み→character packing→scalar化。行列式論文に使われる標数2入力を供給。
role.en: Punctured finite-geometry pairings, embeddings, character packing, and scalarization; supplies the characteristic-two input used by the determinant paper.

claim.ja: 有限生成G_D上の整数群環行列AがQ[G_D]上可逆で、Fuglede–Kadison行列式は0と1の間。対数積分は有限かつ負。
claim.en: An integral group-ring matrix over finitely generated G_D is invertible over Q[G_D], has Fuglede–Kadison determinant strictly between 0 and 1, and has a finite negative logarithmic integral.

role.ja: 第2論文のscalar欠損→二進因子分解と実trace差→mod 2^k持上げ→整数行列の行列式。
role.en: Turns paper 2’s scalar defect into a binary factorization/real-trace gap, lifts modulo 2^k, and calculates an integral-matrix determinant.

claim.ja: 一つの指定された奇素数p、位数p⁴の体K、torsionを含む有限生成群Gにscalar対ab=1≠baを構成。全配置上の単射非全射CAを得る。
claim.en: For one specified odd prime p, a field K of order p⁴ and a finitely generated group containing torsion admit a scalar pair ab=1≠ba and an injective nonsurjective CA on all configurations.

role.ja: 高次数modular表現の冪等元→共通central sector→向き付き三角圧縮→有限群因子でscalar化。標数2論文への依存なし。
role.en: High-degree modular idempotents, a common central sector, directed triangular compression, and finite-factor scalarization; does not depend on the characteristic-two paper.
